chat_translation_handoff.instruction: Before translating later chapters, read state.json first. Reuse unchanged canonical authorities already loaded in the same project chat, but freshly read every newly named or changed supplement. Read config.json, the canonical terminology TSV, the core style guide, every terminology, style, owner-edit, world-reference, and continuity supplement named in this handoff, chat-fast-path.md, and the registered project-source file Being A Talent: World Reference and Appendix when relevant. Repository files outrank chat memory; the canonical glossary and latest owner ruling override older reference entries. HARD STRUCTURE RULE: preserve exactly one target paragraph per Chinese source paragraph, in identical order. Never merge adjacent source paragraphs and never split a source paragraph merely for English flow. Apply scene break `---` only when warranted by the source/project convention. Italicize explicit and unmistakable implicit internal thought, but do not convert third-person free indirect narration into first-person italics solely because it reports reasoning. Direct thought follows the thought-moment rather than blanket narrative backshift: a completed exchange may be past, a capability unused up to now may be present perfect, and standing judgments and general truths remain present or modal present. Completed alternative history requires the counterfactual perfect, and an event anterior to that hypothetical outcome requires past perfect. Use natural contractions except those ending in 'd; allowed forms such as would've and could've should not be expanded without a voice or emphasis reason. Preserve all source meaning, numbers, logical relations, idioms, allusions, jokes, metaphor chains, and deliberate modern slang in polished xianxia English. Apply the latest owner style directly: compact causal explanations, forceful accurate action, clear combat geography, short emphatic beats, and no repeated explanation. Preserve established capitalized Dao Lord pronouns where applicable. SOURCE CHECK RULE: the separate review must audit time relationships, natural contractions, every locked term and capitalization, exact title and affiliation relationships, natural xianxia phrasing, idiom imagery, omissions, additions, numbers, logic, and paragraph alignment before running mechanical checks.
